findings.risk: The AmazonEKSClusterPolicy includes permissions that may be broader than necessary for the EKS cluster, potentially allowing more access than needed.
findings.remediation: Review the permissions in AmazonEKSClusterPolicy and attach only the necessary permissions required for the EKS cluster to function.

findings.risk: The AmazonEKSServicePolicy includes permissions that may be broader than necessary for the EKS service, potentially allowing more access than needed.
findings.remediation: Review the permissions in AmazonEKSServicePolicy and attach only the necessary permissions required for the EKS service to function.

findings.risk: Instances launched in this subnet will be assigned a public IP by default, which may expose them to the internet.
findings.remediation: Set map_public_ip_on_launch to false to prevent instances from being assigned a public IP by default.
